reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which matches the rendered output — all four paragraphs are unchanged from the originals.

The cited text supports compliance: Section 3.1(a) grants Sanofi (our party, the licensee) an exclusive licence and Section 3.5(a) binds RevMed not to work on SHP2 Inhibitor products outside the Collaboration — exclusivity running in our favour, which the detection guidance expressly treats as acceptable.

No requirements, sole-supplier or 'shall not procure from third parties' obligation is imposed on Sanofi; Section 7.2(c) in fact obliges RevMed to help Sanofi establish its own Third Party supply arrangements, confirming freedom to source elsewhere. The deterministic check agrees.

The rationale correctly characterises Section 12.2(d) as a conditional termination right (not a covenant restricting Sanofi from developing a Competing Product) and notes it as a residual soft restraint rather than escalating it into a deviation — an appropriate 'noted in rationale' treatment under the classification semantics.
